segments.name: Dispensing and Specialty Closures
segments.description: Manufactures dispensing and specialty closures for fragrance and beauty, food, beverage, personal and health care, home care and lawn and garden markets worldwide.
segments.evidence: We are a leading worldwide manufacturer and supplier of dispensing and specialty closures for the fragrance and beauty, food, beverage, personal and health care, home care and lawn and garden markets.

segments.name: Metal Containers
segments.description: Manufactures steel and aluminum containers for pet and human food and general line products in North America and Europe.
segments.evidence: We are also a leading manufacturer and supplier of metal containers in North America and Europe, and in North America we are the largest manufacturer of metal food containers with a unit volume market share in the United States in 2025 of more than half of the market.

segments.name: Custom Containers
segments.description: Manufactures custom designed plastic containers in North America for pet and human food, consumer health and pharmaceutical, personal care, home care, lawn and garden and automotive markets.
segments.evidence: Additionally, we are a leading manufacturer and supplier of custom containers in North America for a variety of markets, including the pet and human food, consumer health and pharmaceutical, personal care, home care, lawn and garden and automotive markets.

revenueModel.text: Consumer products companies pay Silgan for rigid packaging products, largely under multi-year supply arrangements, with revenue recognized at shipment or over time for certain production contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: We estimate that in 2026 approximately 90 percent of our projected metal container sales and a majority of our projected dispensing and specialty closures and custom container sales will be under multi-year customer supply arrangements.

changes.text: In 2024, the company acquired Weener Plastics Holding B.V., whose results were included in the dispensing and specialty closures segment.
changes.evidence: Weener Packaging's results of operations were included in our dispensing and specialty closures segment since the acquisition date.
